page.layout: One title page, centred within a woodcut border; no running text. Printed lines only, in reading order from top to bottom.
page.notes: Woodcut border on all four sides with putti and foliage; not transcribed. Handwritten "10." at top right and a "10" label at lower right are handwriting/library marks and are omitted. The "4" before "Maij" appears as a small printed mark, read as printed. Show-through from the reverse page is visible faintly and omitted.
